english.note: This is the all-purpose noun for a pastime or activity used to occupy the mind.
Use this for a pastime or activity chosen to pass the time pleasantly, rather than entertainment in general.
Use this for an enjoyable pastime or activity used to occupy oneself.

examples.english: I like reading as a diversion in my daily life.
examples.traditional: 我平日鍾意睇書當消遣。
examples.jyutping: ngo5 ping4 jat6 zung1 ji3 tai2 syu1 dong3 siu1 hin2

examples.english: I enjoy fishing as amusement when I’m off.
examples.jyutping: ngo5 fong3 gaa3 zung1 ji3 diu3 jyu4 siu1 hin2

examples.english: Reading novels is my favourite form of enjoyment.
examples.traditional: 睇吓小說係我最鍾意嘅消遣。
